SENTHIL T R 
Chennai, India | +91 7449154084 | trs2197@gmail.com 
 
 
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
 
Results-driven Routing Engineer with 6.5+ years of experience in IP/MPLS service provider networks, specializing in BGP, 
OSPF, and IS-IS configuration, route policy implementation, and routing protocol troubleshooting. Demonstrated hands-on 
expertise across Cisco IOS-XR, IOS-XE, and Juniper JUNOS platforms, with a proven track record of zero-impact migrations, 
peer provisioning, MPLS L2/L3 VPN deployment, and proactive network performance optimization. Collaborative team 
player with a growing focus on network automation and AI-assisted configuration management. 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
 
 
Network Engineer 2 – IP Network Implementation Sep 2023 – Present 
Comcast – Chennai, India 
◗ Implement in-life routing and configuration changes across Sky's core IP network; troubleshoot BGP session and 
connectivity issues to maintain high availability and service stability. 
◗ Lead network migration activities, decommissioning legacy routers and re-engineering BGP peering and routing paths 
to transition live traffic to new platforms with zero service impact during scheduled maintenance windows. 
◗ Execute lifecycle management activities — replacing end-of-life (EOL/EOS) hardware (route processors, fabric cards, 
fan trays) and validating routing protocol convergence post-replacement to maintain network reliability. 
◗ Lead peer provisioning for private, public, and transit networks — configuring, establishing, and troubleshooting BGP 
sessions, including session resets, route policy mismatches, and prefix filtering issues, to ensure seamless connectivity. 
◗ Perform IOS-XE and IOS-XR software upgrades on Cisco NCS 5500 routers and Catalyst 9300/9200 switches, verifying 
routing protocol stability and adjacency states pre- and post-upgrade. 
◗ Manage and support the DCN (Sky's out-of-band management network), ensuring reliable console and device access 
for routing troubleshooting during outages. 
◗ Upgrade Link Aggregation Groups (LAGs) by adding member interfaces to existing bundles, improving network capacity 
and resilience. 
 
Technical Delivery Associate – Global Network Change Jun 2022 – Aug 2023 
BT Group Plc – Bangalore, India 
◗ Executed hardware upgrades on BT's global network devices, including Cisco ASR (ESP, RP, and power modules) and 
Juniper MX (SCB, RE, and PEM) components. 
◗ Performed software upgrades on Cisco ASR 1013/1002-X and Juniper MX960 devices (IOS/JUNOS), confirming routing 
protocol stability following each upgrade. 
◗ Executed configuration changes across MPLS and Internet platforms, including ACL updates, to enhance network 
security and routing performance. 
◗ Handled acceptance and cessation of trunk links for MPLS and Internet platforms, validating routing adjacency and 
traffic flow before and after each cutover. 
◗ Coordinated with field engineers on line card and optics installation across Cisco and Juniper devices. 
◗ Developed a SQL query to streamline the retrieval of line card, router, and switch details for MPLS and Internet 
platforms, improving overall team efficiency. 
Engineer – Global IP Network Design & Engineering Sep 2019 – Jun 2022 
Tata Communications Limited – Chennai, India 
◗ Strategically planned and designed telecom infrastructure and routing architecture for new IP Points of Presence 
(PoPs), supporting network expansion and service delivery. 
◗ Managed the addition of 1G/10G/100G links, increasing backhaul capacity and validating routing and traffic 
distribution to support growing network demands. 
◗ Analysed network and routing performance by proactively monitoring port health and BGP stability; initiated Bill of 
Materials (BOM) requests to resolve port capacity constraints in the IP network. 
◗ Designed and validated routing scenarios (BGP, OSPF) in lab environments based on customer requirements; 
presented solutions to cross-functional teams for production implementation. 
◗ Validated and tested routing protocol behaviour on new platform routers prior to production deployment, ensuring 
stability through traffic generation using IXIA. 
◗ Performed end-to-end IPsec VPN configuration, troubleshooting, and partner validation for Tata IZO service 
deployments, ensuring reliable connectivity, routing integrity, and adherence to service quality standards across 
customer CPE environments 
◗ Supported customer and backbone network migrations, including legacy device decommissioning (Cisco to Juniper) 
and routing path re-validation. 
◗ Performed card grooming to diagnose and resolve port capacity constraints across the network.
